messages:
zoe (eng-ml): Quick check-in on newton12b-2026-05 quant runs. Did a focused int8/int6 sweep on sampled traffic (4k reqs). Need a concise recommendation for GTN defaults + minimal canary plan.
omar (ml): please paste the smoke numbers.
zoe (eng-ml): summary below (smoke + eval subsets):
```
model: newton12b-2026-05
variants: fp16, int8, int6
latency p50/p95 (ms): fp16 50/135, int8 53/150, int6 56/165
throughput (tokens/sec): fp16 180, int8 195, int6 225
quality (QA EM / perplexity on eval): fp16 92.0 / 12.6, int8 91.7 / 12.9, int6 90.8 / 13.5
approx token cost per 1k: fp16 $0.0020, int8 $0.0013, int6 $0.0009
```
rachel (prod): cost savings vs int8 is notable. Any concentrated regressions?
zoe (eng-ml): two small hotspots: multi-turn code-edit slice ~1.4 EM drop int6 vs int8; legal-contract longform templates ~1.1 EM drop and p95 latency +80ms. Chat, FAQ, rerank fine (<0.3 EM).
omar (ml): recommendation: map default->int8 for new GTN tenants, standard chat routes can be int6 opt-in, high-fidelity routes pinned to fp16. For faster wins, enable int6 on low-risk assistant routes only.
vic (gtn): product question: can we automate a per-tenant staging that starts int6 but escalates to int8 for longform detection?
zoe (eng-ml): yes: propose hybrid rule: inspect prompt length or route tag; route to int6 by default, switch to int8 if prompt >1024 tokens or route has tag high_fidelity. Canary plan: 48h at 20% traffic, distributed probes (150 chat, 60 longform, 30 code-edit) running every 5m. Fallback: auto-switch to int8 when probe EM delta >1.0 sustained 20m or p95 latency increase >40% 15m.
canary-bot: canary created id=nw-2026-05-15, start=2026-05-15T14:00:00Z, traffic=20%, fallback=int8, alerts=#eng-ml-ops
rachel (prod): +1. Add product advisory: "Default for new tenants: int8. Offer int6 as cost-saving option mapped to per-route 'eco' setting; fp16 reserved for regulated/high-fidelity." Also require opt-in for int6 on managed GTN.
vic (gtn): will draft GTN copy and the per-route knob UX.
omar (ml): I'll own probe sets and live delta dashboard. Will also run the replay sim for hybrid rule overnight.
zoe (eng-ml): action items: omar -> probes + replay sim, rachel -> advisory draft, vic -> GTN mapping + UX, zoe -> rollout checklist + monitoring alerts. Decision: launch canary now per bot. Closing thread.
